CustomField.description: 36950 : Booking Verification: (India) Hide Account Setup link until Booking Verification = Pass - PLNI0018180
CustomField.formula: IF( IF(QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c ='India' && (Amount / CURRENCYRATE(TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode))) >= 5000, /* If India: Must be Stage 5/6 AND Booking Verification must be Pass */ AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'6 - Setup')), ISPICKVAL(Deal_Validation__c,'Pass') ), /* For all other countries: Just needs to be Stage 5/6 */ OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,'5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName,'6 - Setup')) ), HYPERLINK("/apex/IME_CreateCase_Lightning?oppId="+ Id+"&Type=AccountSetup", "Account Setup"), '' )
CustomField.label: Account Setup
